items.headline: Price move coincides with 2 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 3847.04/MWh on 2026-05-06, same day as: YERMARUS TPP unit 2: 800.0 MW affected; ADANI POWER unit 2: 600.0 MW affected (~1400 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
